text.p: Environmental Products & Technologies Corp said Thursday it has successfully tested its non-toxic environmentally safe insecticide to eradicate Texas Fire Ants.
The company said it is working with local, county and state officials in Texas to form a comprehensive program to solve a state-wide problem that causes in excess of $90 million in damages annually.
Of the 254 counties across the state of Texas, 136 of them are currently under quarantine to reduce the spread of fire ants, the company noted.
Environmental Products said its non-toxic insecticide is designed and approved for use on food crops, including fruits and vegetables.
Upon completion of its 1996 audit, the company added, it expects to file an application for listing of its shares for trading on the Nasdaq -- Small Cap Market.
